## 🐛 Describe the bug

A clear and concise description of what went wrong.

## 🔁 Steps to reproduce

1. Go to '...'
2. Press '...'

What you expected to happen instead.

- **Arena seed** (shown on the title screen): `______`
- **Wave / level:** `______`

Console errors, extra context, ideas on the cause, etc.
